info.name: Atussa API (sequio_backend)
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Atussa backend, generated from the route table in `src/routes/`.

**Start here:** set `baseUrl` (an environment is included for production and local), then run
*01 · Auth → Register*, put the OTP into the `otp` variable, run *Verify email*, and you are
authenticated — the login and verify requests save `accessToken` for everything else.

Requests capture ids as they go (`itemId`, `bookingId`, `conversationId`, …), so running a
folder top to bottom works: create a listing, book it, chat, review, dispute.

Admin requests need an account whose role is `admin`; sign in with it and the same
`accessToken` is reused.

Realtime chat is not covered here — sockets cannot be exercised from Postman. See
`CHAT_REALTIME.md` in the repo.

exec: // a fresh signup email per run, so Register can be re-run without 409
